messages:
maya r.: Quick heads-up — planning to pin meridian-lite-3b@v1 into the model catalog during the quiet window tomorrow. Targeting 15:10 UTC. Who can own smoke + rollback readiness?

samir: I can own the smoke run. Will do the API + perf checks. ETA ~15:12 UTC to post results.

jiro: I'll be on-call for infra fallback. If anything looks off I'll trigger the variant swap. Share rollback command pls.

maya r.: Thanks both. Rollback (manual) is: 
```
redwoodctl catalog unpin --model meridian-lite-3b --version v1 --reason "rollback"
redwoodctl catalog set-alias --alias meridian-lite:stable --target previous_version_id
```
Keep safe copy of previous_version_id from the catalog API.

ops-bot: deploy-scheduler: scheduled pin operation created by @maya r. for 2026-03-23T15:10:00Z. Quiet window expected: 15:05-15:20 UTC.

lucas: FYI I've got a quick preflight checklist: 1) config lint, 2) traffic routing rules double-check, 3) KV cache warmup off flag ready. I'll run 1 & 2 at 15:00 UTC.

ana p.: pinging infra: can we pre-warm the shard group that's going to serve meridian-lite? should save cold-start tokens.

jiro: pre-warm ok. I'll spin the pool at 14:55 and confirm.

samir: Smoke plan: 1) health check: GET /v1/models/meridian-lite-3b/health 2) small gen: POST /v1/generate {prompt: "quick test"} 3) perf: 100 concurrent tokens across 10 reqs. I'll paste results.

maya r.: Perfect. If smoke looks good, I'll proceed with the catalog pin at 15:10 and post the operation id. If not, we'll rollback.

lucas: One more: retention for trace logs — set to 24h for this window. Putting a short tag: `catalog-pin/meridian-lite-3b/v1`.

samir: 15:11 smoke: health OK, gen OK (sample: "OK"), p95 latency 120ms, error 0/10. Posting full logs shortly.

jiro: Pool pre-warm complete at 14:57 UTC. Nodes at expected capacity.

maya r.: Thanks — proceeding to pin now. Operation id: op_2026_372459_01. Will call it here and update if anything unexpected. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy-scheduler: operation op_2026_372459_01 completed successfully. Catalog pin applied.

samir: Quick post-check: 200/200 gen tests pass, slight uptick in tail latency but within SLO. No errors.

jiro: Monitors green. Keeping rollback command ready.

maya r.: Awesome team. Can we add a short note to the catalog entry about the validation prompts used? I'll open PR for that.

lucas: On it — PR opened: #4392 with the prompt set and perf numbers.

ana p.: Thanks everyone. I'll annotate the run in the ops playbook.

maya r.: Closing this thread — great work.
